welcomeEmbed.title: Welcome to the Anti-Xeno Initiative
welcomeEmbed.description: We are an Elite: Dangerous community centered on Thargoid Combat (Anti-Xeno) and defending humanity.

fields.name: Verification
fields.value: Please verify to access the server. Click the Verify button.

oldVersionFallbackEmbed.title: Not working?
oldVersionFallbackEmbed.description: If you cannot see the Verification Challenge, please update your client or click the Old Version button below.
oldVersionFallbackEmbed.queuedDescription: Warden is preparing your verification screen. Please wait a moment.

previewSuccessEmbed.title: Verification Preview Complete
previewSuccessEmbed.description: No verification state, roles, cooldowns, or settings were changed.

failureEmbed.title: Verification Failed
failureEmbed.description: That answer was incorrect. Please try again in {cooldownSeconds} seconds.

inProgressEmbed.title: Verification in Progress
inProgressEmbed.description: You already have a verification challenge in progress. Please answer your current challenge or retry after it expires {retryTime}.

cooldownEmbed.title: Verification Cooldown
cooldownEmbed.description: Please wait before trying verification again. You can retry {retryTime}.

nextScreenProcessingEmbed.title: Preparing Next Screen
nextScreenProcessingEmbed.description: Your next verification screen is processing. Please wait a moment.

busyProcessingEmbed.title: Verification Processing
busyProcessingEmbed.description: Your current verification action is still processing. Please wait.

expiredChallengeEmbed.title: Verification Screen Expired
expiredChallengeEmbed.description: Your current verification screen has expired. Please start verification again.

verificationHelpEmbed.title: Verification Help
verificationHelpEmbed.description:
Click the **Verify** button to start the verification process.
Follow the prompts and read carefully.
Use the **Give Answer** button and fill in the modal.

fields.name: Contact
fields.value:

autoKickEmbed.title: Verification Time Limit
autoKickEmbed.description: You were automaticly removed from **{serverName}** after not completing verification.

fields.name: Why?
fields.value: To protect our server, new members need to verify within {autokickTimer} or they will be removed.

fields.name: Can I try again?
fields.value:
Yes! Rejoin the server and complete verification.

<https://discord.com/invite/antixenoinitiative>

autoKickWelcomeField.title: Time limit
autoKickWelcomeField.value: Please complete verification within {autokickTimer}. If you are still unverified when that timer expires, you will be removed from the server.
